QUOTE: The same empty result also comes back when `vocab_` is null, and when `tokenizer_` is unset in `LlamaCppBackend::tokenize` (`llama_cpp_backend.cpp:795`).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that a failed tokenization returns an empty vector, which is the same value the backend wrapper returns when no tokenizer is wired (`tokenizer_` unset).
